"""
PocketCoffea configuration snippet: cross-product ("cartesian") categorization
combining jet-multiplicity bins with b-tag-multiplicity bins.

- jet multiplicity ("JetGood"): exactly 4, exactly 5, at least 6 jets
- b-tag multiplicity ("BJetGood"): exactly 2, at least 3 b-jets

Instead of hand-writing all 3 x 2 = 6 category combinations, this uses
PocketCoffea's cartesian categorization objects:
  - `MultiCut`         -> a multi-bin cut wrapper for a single binning
  - `CartesianSelection` -> combines several MultiCut objects into the
                            full cross product of categories
"""

from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_functions import get_nObj_eq, get_nObj_min
from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import MultiCut, CartesianSelection

# --- Binning 1: jet multiplicity on the "JetGood" collection -----------------
njet_multicut = MultiCut(
    name="Njet",
    cuts=[
        get_nObj_eq(4, coll="JetGood", name="4j"),
        get_nObj_eq(5, coll="JetGood", name="5j"),
        get_nObj_min(6, coll="JetGood", name="6PlusJ"),
    ],
    cuts_names=["4j", "5j", "6PlusJ"],
)

# --- Binning 2: b-tag multiplicity on the "BJetGood" collection --------------
nbjet_multicut = MultiCut(
    name="Nbjet",
    cuts=[
        get_nObj_eq(2, coll="BJetGood", name="2b"),
        get_nObj_min(3, coll="BJetGood", name="3PlusB"),
    ],
    cuts_names=["2b", "3PlusB"],
)

# --- Cartesian combination container: cross product of the two binnings -----
categories = CartesianSelection(
    multicuts=[njet_multicut, nbjet_multicut],
)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # 3 (jet bins) x 2 (b-jet bins) = 6 categories, generated automatically
    print(categories)
